crm_notes: Mid-market B2B SaaS (product analytics) looking to add in-product assistant + doc search
Priority: EU customer data residency (must not send PII outside EU). Quote: 'If EU data leaves region we can't sign'
Short term plan: start on Hosted API for speed of integration, run 2-week POC, then evaluate Dedicated for predictable throughput and VPC/network isolation
Latency target: 80-150ms tail for short chat completions for EU users; okay to have higher latency for long-form generation
Throughput: bursty — typical 20 TPS, peak 150 TPS during product events; want autoscale/burst guarantees
Cost sensitivity: mid — will trade some cost for SLA but target ARR band ~50-150k; asked for quantized model price comparison
Model preference: open/compatible models (Llama-family variants) + Redwood-verified performance profiles; wants fallback to smaller quantized variant if capacity constrained
Routing: prefer EU-region primary with automatic failover to NA only for non-PII or aggregated telemetry; need controls to prevent cross-border for regulated customers
Security asks: SSO for console, SAML provisioning, audit logs per request, KMS integration for key ownership, 90d retention by default and retain/erase policies
Quote from CPO: 'We need a migration path from API to Dedicated without redoing prompts or SDK calls'
poc_details: POC length: 2 weeks (prod-like traffic spike test on week 2)
Scope: chat & semantic search on EU dataset (customer docs, support transcripts), correctness/regression tests on prompt set
Metrics: 95th percentile latency EU, token cost per 1M tokens, model output quality (human eval A/B vs baseline), availability during simulated region failover
Success criteria: meet latency target or demonstrate tradeoff with cost; show Dedicated latency improvements and config for prefix caching; legal sign-off on data residency approach
Deliverables: Hosted API pilot key, Dedicated trial quote (monthly commit options), security FAQ response and architecture diagram, POC wrap-up deck
